blocks.text: Polygenic inheritance aur epistasis bhi Mendel ke virasat ke qawaneen se hat kar (deviation) hone ki misalein hain. Dono mein aik se zyada genes shamil hote hain; agle do topics mein in ko alag alag parhenge.

blocks.prompt: Polygenic inheritance aur epistasis mein kya cheez mushtarak (common) hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono mein aik khasiyat par aik se zyada genes ka asar hota hai, is liye dono Mendel ki seedhi 3:1 ya 9:3:3:1 ratios se hat jate hain.

items: Polygenic inheritance aur epistasis: Mendel ke qawaneen se hat kar virasat ki do soorten, dono mein kai genes.
